prompt.project_info: Create a warm luxury goddess-inspired portrait of an approved adult woman in a white-and-gold outfit inside a modern apartment.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with fair skin, oval face, light eyes, soft makeup, relaxed confident expression and slight smile, and long straight platinum-blonde hair with a center part. She wears a white halter-style fashion bodysuit with a flattering deep V neckline, thin gold belt detail, sheer white wrap overlay, gold leaf crown, coin choker, arm cuffs, and coin waist chain. Keep the styling elegant and fashion-editorial.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered balanced vertical mid-thigh-to-head portrait, eye-level framing, subject facing camera with relaxed shoulders, modern apartment background with wood floors, light rug, neutral curtains, white wall panels, round pendant lights, and distant dining furniture.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm indoor ambient lighting with soft frontal key, subtle side fill, warm ceiling pendants, gentle flattering shadows, and luxury white-and-gold color harmony.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4K/8K-detail portrait, 85mm lens, f/1.8, sharp subject with soft background separation, realistic skin and fabric physics, natural shadows, warm neutral grade, subtle grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a warm photorealistic luxury fashion portrait of an approved adult woman with fair skin, oval face, light eyes, soft makeup, a relaxed confident slight smile, and long straight platinum-blonde hair with a center part flowing over her shoulders. She stands facing the camera with relaxed shoulders and wears a white halter-style fashion bodysuit with a flattering deep V neckline, smooth fabric, thin gold belt detail, a sheer white wrap overlay, a gold leaf crown, gold coin choker, gold arm cuffs, and gold coin waist chain. Compose a centered balanced vertical mid-thigh-to-head portrait at eye level inside a modern apartment with wood floors, light rug, neutral curtains, white wall panels, round pendant lights, and a distant dining table.
